title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me with the keystone to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, who keep what is left of Kothringi lore. I'm to show it to their elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.
objectives: Show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: The keystone from the wreck is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers' elder may know what it opens.
plan.next: Take boats to Lujei Ferry, cross to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I recovered a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, and the keystone seems tied to it.
Go to Toklea, find Hums-the-Long-Note (quest marker), and show the keystone to the Chime-Keepers elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.
I can talk to Hums-the-Long-Note, ask about the elder, or show the keystone. I should stay quiet and careful, since others hunt this.
I do not know who Hums-the-Long-Note is, what the Eye is, or what the keystone does. I could find out by asking the Chime-Keepers.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone, and named her price: her family's carved grave-stake lies in a chest in the drowned street of Zul-Etha, and she wants it raised. Crocodiles lie on the roof peaks above it. I may kill them from a roof or from range, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen to the chest.
objectives: Raise the grave-stake from the chest in Zul-Etha's drowned street. (marker: Drowned Chest)

plan.going: The elder will say what the keystone opens if I raise her family's grave-stake.
plan.next: Go to Zul-Etha and take the grave-stake from the chest under the water.
plan.ways: Kill the crocodiles (from a roof or from range), calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen.
terms: Zul-Etha: Hums-the-Long-Note: a carting village the washes drowned, south-east of Mir-Xal

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note is the Chime-Keepers elder. She knows the keystone but wants payment first: her family grave-stake from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha.
Go to Zul-Etha (from Mir-Xal quay, south-east), reach the Drowned Chest, raise the grave-stake, bring it back to her.
Kill the crocodiles and old bull from a roof or with arrows, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen. Quiet fits my build, so swimming or sneaking is best.
I do not know where exactly Mir-Xal quay is relative to here, or whether the chest is locked. I can find out via the map marker and by looking.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note took her family's stake and kept her word: the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin near Gideon. The Kothringi knights of Gideon were the last to guard the kings' road to the Root. I'm to tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom what the keystone opens. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike, on the old road to the Root.
terms: Eurydike and the knights of Gideon: Hums-the-Long-Note: the hall of Kothringi knights who served in Gideon's garrison and guarded the kings' road to the Root

answers: Hums kept her word: the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin north of Gideon. The knights guarded the kings road to the Root.
Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go straight to Nesh-Deeka, or perhaps visit Eurydike myself later; the journal asks me to report first.
I do not know what the Root is exactly, nor what the captain was buried with. Nesh-Deeka or the tomb may tell me.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard me out. She already knew that the Unbound have been asking Gideon's diggers about Eurydike. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and told me to hurry. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The Unbound are close behind on the same trail; Nesh-Deeka knows it and will not say how.
plan.next: MN09 starts; its first entry marks Eurydike.

answers: The quest is done. I learned the keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike near Gideon, which holds what marked the way to the Root. The Unbound are already asking about Eurydike, and Nesh-Deeka wants me quick. She paid me 100 gold.
Nothing is set; the likely next step is to go to Eurydike near Gideon before the Unbound.
Go to Eurydike myself and open the tomb quietly, or ask Nesh-Deeka more.
I do not know what the Root is, what the Eye is, or how Nesh-Deeka listens.
